  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Definition of Done for a Shipped Skill Bundle</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A merge-gate checklist the platform team enforces in CI on any new or changed Skill bundle.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-21-skill-bundle-definition-of-done</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>11</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Primitives as Code</b>, <i>Modules over monoliths</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook\ch21-primitives-as-code.qmd</code> L58-72 (checks 11-12: <code>ch22-the-reference-architecture-earned.qmd</code> L119-121) &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch21-primitives-as-code.html#sec-primitives-modules">#sec-primitives-modules</a>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill one gate per bundle, per version, before merge. Give every one of the twelve checks a verdict, and for every <b>pass</b> write evidence a reviewer can open: a path, a CI job name or a run link. An assertion is not evidence. Say whether a machine or a person enforces each check, and name the CI job wherever you write <b>CI (automated)</b>. A <b>not applicable</b> needs its reason written in the evidence column. Waive a <b>fail</b> only with a reason and an expiry date; otherwise it blocks. Check 2 is answered by the reason-to-change question, never by counting lines.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Header block <span class="ws-block-note">one per merge request</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:3%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:3%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:3%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:16%"></colgroup>
      <tbody>
        <tr>

          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td><td><b>Version being published</b></td><td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>

        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

    <div class="ws-instruction">The book places checks 7-10 inside the CI gate: "Internal to the package; CI gate." (ch21 L66). Column 4, "Enforced by", is decided once for the gate, not per bundle. Checks 11 and 12 are not manifest fields today &mdash; name a reviewer. Column numbers in the headers are the ones used in the text. Check 2 (this sheet's rule, not the book's): score by the reason-to-change question only; write the answer in column 5, either "no section has an independent reason to change" or the sections that do.</div>

If column 4 is set to reviewer judgement for any of 7-10, write the reason in column 5. A "not applicable" also needs its reason in column 5. A job name in column 6 is required wherever column 4 reads CI (automated); column 7 applies only to a fail.</div>
